modules.title: Introduction to Agụmagụ Ede (Written Literature)
modules.html:
Igbo prose, poetry and drama. This section covers introduction to agụmagụ ede (written literature).

Key points

  • Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa' (Written literature) — Akwụkwọ akụkọ (Novel).
  • Agụmagụ Igbo pụrụ ịbụ nke edere ede ma ọ bụ nke... — ọnụ.
  • Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ ọnụ' — Ilu na Akụkọ ifo.
  • Agụmagụ 'Egwuregwu' bụ _____. — Drama.
  • Agụmagụ 'Ewì' na-ekwusi ike na kedu ihe — Ahịrị uri.

Worked examples

Q: Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa' (Written literature)?
A: Akwụkwọ akụkọ (Novel) — Written literature (Agụmagụ a kpara akpa) consists of texts recorded in writing, unlike oral literature.

Q: Agụmagụ Igbo pụrụ ịbụ nke edere ede ma ọ bụ nke...
A: ọnụ — Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: ọnụ.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa' (Written literature)?
quiz.solution: Written literature (Agụmagụ a kpara akpa) consists of texts recorded in writing, unlike oral literature.

quiz.q: Agụmagụ Igbo pụrụ ịbụ nke edere ede ma ọ bụ nke...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: ọnụ.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ ọnụ'?
quiz.solution: Proverbs and folktales are transmitted orally, hence 'Agụmagụ ọnụ'.

quiz.q: Agụmagụ 'Egwuregwu' bụ _____.
quiz.solution: 'Egwuregwu' refers to plays or drama meant for performance.

quiz.q: Agụmagụ 'Ewì' na-ekwusi ike na kedu ihe?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ahịrị uri.

quiz.q: Kedu aha a na-akpọ onye na-ede akụkọ?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Odeakụkọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ada' n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: 'Ada' is the title for the first-born daughter in an Igbo family.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Mmanwụ' n'ala Igbo?
options: Nwoke kpuru ihe n'ihu na-anọchite anya ndị mmụọ
quiz.solution: Masquerades (mmanwụ) are believed to be the spirits of ancestors returning to the physical world.

quiz.q: N'ala Igbo, gịnị bụ 'Chi'?
options: Mmụọ nche onye ọ bụla nwere
quiz.solution: In Igbo cosmology, 'Chi' is an individual's personal guardian spirit or divine spark.

quiz.q: Olee akaraolu a na-eji egosi 'Low Tone' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: The low tone is indicated by the grave accent mark (`) on the vowel.

quiz.q: Olee anụmanụ a maara dị ka onye aghụghọ n'akụkọ ifo Igbo?
quiz.solution: The Tortoise (Mbe) is the archetypal trickster in Igbo folktales.

quiz.q: Olee onye dere akwụkwọ 'Juọ Obinna'?
quiz.solution: Tony Ubesie wrote 'Juọ Obinna', another famous novel about the civil war.

quiz.q: Onye na-ele anya n'ọdịnihu site n'ịgba afa bụ _____.
quiz.solution: A diviner is known as 'Dibia afa'.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Verb'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ngwaa.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Welcome'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nnọọ.

quiz.q: Akwụkwọ J.U.T. Nzeako:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Juochi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Snake'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Agwọ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Come'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Bịa.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Mkpuruokwu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Word.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Egwuregwu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Play/Game.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Akwụkwọ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Book/Leaf.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Onu'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Mouth/Hole.

quiz.q: Su waye 'Makada'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Drummers/Singers.

quiz.q: Menene kishiyar kalmar 'Fari'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Baki.

quiz.q: Wane ne Allah?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Mahalicci (Creator).

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Wata'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Moon/Month.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'White' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ọcha.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Salt' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Nnu.

quiz.q: Mgbochiume ole dị n'abịdịị Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Iri abụọ na asatọ.

quiz.q: Kedu ngwa egwu a na-eji eme mkpọtụ n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ekwe.

quiz.q: Obodo 'Iri Ji':
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Ala Igbo.
